mapper.select: SELECT M.MSG_ID AS msgId, M.CS_ID AS csId, M.SENDER_ID AS senderId, M.SENDER_TYPE AS senderType, M.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, M.TITLE AS title, M.CONTENT AS content, M.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM CS_MESSAGES M LEFT JOIN CS_CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = M.CATEGORY_ID WHERE M.CS_ID = #{csId} ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT ASC, M.MSG_ID ASC
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CS_ID AS csId, USER_ID AS userId, EXT_KEY AS extKey, CS_STATUS AS csStatus FROM CS_LOGS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CS_STATUS = 'OPEN' ORDER BY CS_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT CS_ID AS csId, USER_ID AS userId, EXT_KEY AS extKey, CS_STATUS AS csStatus FROM CS_LOGS WHERE CS_ID = #{csId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT L.CS_ID AS csId, L.USER_ID AS userId, L.CS_STATUS AS csStatus, FM.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, FM.TITLE AS title, LM.CONTENT AS lastContent, LM.SENDER_ID AS lastSenderId, LM.SENDER_TYPE AS lastSenderType, FM.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, LM.CREATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM CS_LOGS L JOIN ( SELECT CS_ID, CATEGORY_ID, TITLE, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT M.CS_ID, M.CATEGORY_ID, M.TITLE, M.CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY M.CS_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT ASC, M.MSG_ID ASC ) AS RN FROM CS_MESSAGES M ) WHERE RN = 1 ) FM ON FM.CS_ID = L.CS_ID JOIN ( SELECT CS_ID, CONTENT, SENDER_ID, SENDER_TYPE, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT M.CS_ID, M.CONTENT, M.SENDER_ID, M.SENDER_TYPE, M.CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY M.CS_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC, M.MSG_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM CS_MESSAGES M ) WHERE RN = 1 ) LM ON LM.CS_ID = L.CS_ID LEFT JOIN CS_CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = FM.CATEGORY_ID WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY LM.CREATED_AT DESC, L.CS_ID DESC

SELECT L.CS_ID AS csId, L.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.EMAIL AS email, L.EXT_KEY AS extKey, L.CS_STATUS AS csStatus, FM.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, FM.TITLE AS title, LM.CONTENT AS lastContent, LM.SENDER_ID AS lastSenderId, LM.SENDER_TYPE AS lastSenderType, FM.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, LM.CREATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM CS_LOGS L JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID JOIN ( SELECT CS_ID, CATEGORY_ID, TITLE, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT M.CS_ID, M.CATEGORY_ID, M.TITLE, M.CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY M.CS_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT ASC, M.MSG_ID ASC ) AS RN FROM CS_MESSAGES M ) WHERE RN = 1 ) FM ON FM.CS_ID = L.CS_ID JOIN ( SELECT CS_ID, CONTENT, SENDER_ID, SENDER_TYPE, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT M.CS_ID, M.CONTENT, M.SENDER_ID, M.SENDER_TYPE, M.CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY M.CS_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC, M.MSG_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM CS_MESSAGES M ) WHERE RN = 1 ) LM ON LM.CS_ID = L.CS_ID LEFT JOIN CS_CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = FM.CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY LM.CREATED_AT DESC, L.CS_ID DESC
SELECT CS_ID AS csId, USER_ID AS userId, EXT_KEY AS extKey, CS_STATUS AS csStatus FROM CS_LOGS WHERE CS_ID = #{csId}

SELECT ATTACHMENT_ID AS attachmentId, MSG_ID AS msgId, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, STORED_NAME AS storedName, CONTENT_TYPE AS contentType, FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM CS_MESSAGE_ATTACHMENTS WHERE ATTACHMENT_ID = #{attachmentId}

SELECT A.ATTACHMENT_ID AS attachmentId, A.MSG_ID AS msgId, A.ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, A.STORED_NAME AS storedName, A.CONTENT_TYPE AS contentType, A.FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, A.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM CS_MESSAGE_ATTACHMENTS A JOIN CS_MESSAGES M ON M.MSG_ID = A.MSG_ID JOIN CS_LOGS L ON L.CS_ID = M.CS_ID WHERE A.ATTACHMENT_ID = #{attachmentId} AND L.USER_ID = #{userId}
